name: signaling lymphocytic activation molecule family member 1

function.text: SLAMF1 encodes signaling lymphocytic activation molecule. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor activity and virus receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and immune response.

function.text: SLAMF1 encodes signaling lymphocytic activation molecule. Based in part on similarity, activities are controlled by presence or absence of small cytoplasmic adapter proteins, SH2D1A/SAP and/or SH2D1B/EAT-2. SLAMF1-induced signal-transduction events in T-lymphocytes are different from those in B-cells. Initially it has been proposed that association with SH2D1A prevents binding to inhibitory effectors including INPP5D/SHIP1 and PTPN11/SHP-2.
